name: claim_selected_detail
xsql:
SELECT Nvl(MAX(c.claim_id), '')                                         AS claim_id,
       Nvl(MAX(c.participant_name), '')                                 AS participant_name,
       Nvl(MAX(c.period_name), '')                                      AS period_name,
       Nvl(MAX(c.order_code), '')                                       AS order_code,
       Nvl(MAX(c.item_code), '')                                        AS item_code,
       Nvl(MAX(c.customer_name), '')                                    AS customer_name,
       Nvl(MAX(c.reason_code), '')                                      AS reason_code,
       Nvl(MAX(c.reason_notes), '')                                     AS reason_notes,
       Nvl(MAX(c.status), 'No claim selected')                          AS status,
       FormatNumber(Nvl(MAX(c.claim_amount), 0), '$#,###0.00')          AS claim_amount,
       FormatNumber(Nvl(MAX(c.credited_amount), 0), '$#,###0.00')       AS credited_amount,
       Nvl(FormatDateTime(MAX(c.submitted_date), 'dd MMM yyyy'), '')    AS submitted_date
FROM   claim.claim_request c
WHERE  c.claim_id = :v_claim_id
